metadata.title: The Influence of Orbital Eccentricity on Tidal Radii of Star Clusters

notes: No eligible individual stars are studied. The paper simulates star clusters and discusses stars becoming unbound from those model clusters (e.g., T:p4-b1–T:p4-b3, T:p7-b11–T:p7-b15), not stars identified as unbound from the Milky Way. Named objects such as Pal 5, NGC 6397, and Pal 14 are globular clusters referenced for context, not individual Galactic unbound candidates.
